hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Take F(y)=Im(polygamma(0,1/2+I*y)). G0001 is recovered by the identity operator. G0002 is recovered by the explicit operator O_tanh[F](y)=(pi/2)*tanh(pi*y), which is the closed form asserted by the DLMF identity. G0003 is recovered by the difference operator O_diff[F](y)=F(y)-O_tanh[F](y).
required_assumptions: 1/2 + I*y is not a nonpositive integer (so polygamma(0, ·) is defined)
tanh has no poles on the real axis
proof_obligations: G0001 - G0002 == 0 for real y, i.e. Im(polygamma(0,1/2+I*y)) - (pi/2)*tanh(pi*y) == 0
G0003 == 0 for real y under the same identity
hypotheses.rationale: The catalog contains the left side, the right side, and their difference. The shared structure is a real-valued function of y whose two syntactic forms are related by the given functional identity. The proof obligation is the exact identity between the two forms.
